scope: offline material and differentiable density-path audit; no FDTD, thermal, electrical, adjoint, or optimization solve

gold_optical_endpoint.source: Ordal et al., Applied Optics 26, 744-752 (1987), exact tabulated 10.0-um row

transport_references_at_approximately_30.electrical_source: Ordal 1985 optical resistivity 2.43 micro-ohm cm; used only as a bulk reference until film data are fixed
transport_references_at_approximately_30.thermal_source: NIST compilation value for well-annealed high-purity bulk Au at 300 K
transport_references_at_approximately_30.thin_film_warning: sigma, kappa, and Seebeck are fabrication- and thickness-dependent; bulk values are references, not promoted film values

production_candidate.law: linear complex refractive index followed by epsilon=n^2
production_candidate.meaning: numerical topology relaxation only; gray rho is not claimed to be a physical Au/air effective medium
production_candidate.fallback: sharp-interface level-set/shape optimization if solver readback, binary equivalence, or AD-FD fails
